text.en:
A commercial registration, and the questions start
Activity and structure chosen before the business is assessed
Approvals pursued one by one, with different parties
Tax, banking and office arranged later, alone
Support ends once the company is registered
text.ar:
سجل تجاري، ثم تبدأ الأسئلة
اختيار النشاط والهيكل قبل تقييم العمل
ملاحقة الموافقات واحدة تلو الأخرى مع جهات مختلفة
ترتيب الضرائب والبنك والمكتب لاحقاً وبمفردك
ينتهي الدعم بمجرد تسجيل الشركة

text.en:
The business evaluated before the paperwork begins
The right activity, structure, location and approvals from day one
One coordinated team from investment decision to operation
Tax, compliance, banking, office and HR prepared for operation
Support that continues after formation, into growth and expansion
text.ar:
